scope: fixed ZFD source and output audit; no corpus regeneration or alternate candidate

setup.decoder: pinned zfd_decoder_v2.py imported after hash checks with bytecode writes disabled; module main is not called
inputs: two source files named by data/source_manifest.json
setup.output: new exclusive JSON receipt under the ignored zfd-replication results directory

steps.expect: Frozen plan, addendum, external source manifest commit and relevant source hashes, local transcript manifest entries, and transcript bytes all match pins before decoder import.
Call eva_to_croatian on qokeedy, chedy, shol, daiin and compare exact outputs to kostedi, hedi, šol, dain.
Record decomposition, residue, confidence, classification, recognized-character numerator/denominator, and resolution counters for the same four tokens.

Deep-copy the lexicon; replace only string values in meaning_en, meaning_hr, latin, latin_full, grammatical_function with unique opaque labels. Forms, keys, ordering, and all other values remain equal.
Matched forms, residues, confidence, classifications, code scores, and resolution counters agree. Generated glosses are compared separately and a changed-gloss flag is recorded.

Parse both pinned sources in split mode. Restrict to f88r P0 lines. Record exact consecutive-token and raw dot-separated substring counts, eligible line/token counts, exclusions, and source/locus provenance. Emit no raw line text.
Record setup, exact rerun command, plan/script/source hashes, each check result, counts, limits, and failure reasons. Do not include full transcription or full translation text.

failure_modes: Any frozen hash or commit mismatch stops the run before decoder import.
Missing or malformed source, lexicon, or manifest stops the run with a recorded error.
Decoder import error or import-time side effect stops the run; module main must not run and no bytecode file may be written.
Any exact guide output mismatch is reported for that example. It does not reject every version or Croatian.
Semantic replacement changes any key, form, non-semantic value, order, decomposition, residue, confidence, classification, score, or resolution counter.
f88r selection includes a non-P0 record, uncertain separator, unreadable marker, or excluded token as eligible.
The output file exists; the run must fail without replacing it.
Receipt includes a complete source line, a complete translation, or private local path.
claim_limits: The four guide examples are known examples, not blind validation.
Code scores measure character matching; they are not correctness probabilities.
Metric agreement after semantic replacement tests confidence independence from those meaning labels; it does not show that any label is false.
The f88r check covers only the fixed folio, exact order, exact spelling, and two pinned sources.
This audit does not validate a manuscript key, language, or translation.
